historical_news_reactions.example_headline: RELIANCE Q2 beats estimates, raises FY24 guidance
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Buy on day 1-2, hold 30 days for PEAD drift

historical_news_reactions.example_headline: INFY Q3 misses, lowers FY24 guidance
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Avoid or short. Don't catch falling knife. PEAD works in reverse.
Acquirer usually drops (deal premium). Target jumps. If you own acquirer, consider exit.

historical_news_reactions.example_headline: SUNPHARMA gets USFDA approval for generic drug
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Buy on approval day. USFDA approval is a significant catalyst for Indian pharma.

historical_news_reactions.example_headline: SUNPHARMA receives FDA warning letter for facility
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Exit immediately. FDA warning letters take 12-18 months to resolve. Don't hold through it.

historical_news_reactions.example_headline: 3 RELIANCE directors buy shares in open market
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Buy within 5 days of cluster buying filing. Insiders know something.

historical_news_reactions.example_headline: TCS promoter (Tata Sons) increases stake via open market
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Strong bullish signal in India. Promoters only buy when very confident. Buy and hold 90 days.

historical_news_reactions.example_headline: ADANI group promoter pledges additional shares
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Red flag. Exit immediately. Promoter pledging = financial stress. Can lead to forced selling spiral.
Buyback provides floor price. Buy on announcement, hold through buyback period.
Block deals indicate institutional activity. Direction depends on buyer/seller identity. Mild bullish if buyer is FII/DII.

historical_news_reactions.example_headline: Govt announces PLI scheme for semiconductor manufacturing
historical_news_reactions.strategy: Buy sector ETF or leaders in the beneficiary sector. Policy-driven rallies last 1-3 months.
Rate hikes hurt rate-sensitive sectors (NBFC, realty, auto). Buy IT (beneficiary of strong USD).
Short paints (raw material cost). Buy ONGC/OIL (beneficiary). Short airlines (fuel cost).
Buy IT exporters (TCS, INFY, WIPRO) and pharma exporters (SUNPHARMA, DRREDDY). Short importers (paints, chemicals).

metadata.data_source: aggregated from 5 years of NSE news reactions
metadata.caveat: These are average reactions. Individual stocks vary. Always check the specific context.
